meta.description: Blind evaluation dataset — 110 cases designed independently from implementation

severity_levels.CRITICAL: Wrong target, ignored negation, fabricated objects/IDs, execution allowed with missing required roles, safety bypass
severity_levels.HIGH: Wrong action type, wrong numeric constraint value, bypassed constraint
severity_levels.MEDIUM: Wrong role assignment, wrong manner/motion state
